meaning.definition: Needed for something to happen or be done.
meaning.example_sentence: A helmet is necessary when we go on this climbing activity.

targets.description: One c and two s letters; word-specific spelling pattern

explanation.script: There is exactly one c and two s letters. One collar and two sleeves is an optional word-specific memory aid.

misconception_examples.say: You have an extra c. This word has one c and two s letters.
One of the two s letters is missing. Let's look at that part together.

provisional_script.explain: There is exactly one c and two s letters. One collar and two sleeves is an optional word-specific memory aid.
provisional_script.guided_practice: Try to spot the single c and the pair of s letters.

provisional_script.definition_offer: Would you like to hear what this word means?
provisional_script.definition: necessary means: Needed for something to happen or be done.
